title: NR CRC Decoder
source_docs: Wireless HDL Toolbox/Error Detection and Correction/NR_CRC_Decoder.md
text: Detect errors in input data using CRC, 3 inputs, 3 outputs, {CRC type} sets Type of CRC; {Full checksum mismatch} enables full checksum and {Enable CRC mask input port} enables CRC checksum mask input port. Values come from the instance.
